Sasha: Morning — quick async: telemetry bumped APAC surge forecast to +30% for 07:20-08:00 UTC. Can we do a rapid prewarm + queue-gating sanity check?
Priya: On it. Prewarm job queued targeting 40 GPUs in apac1 (reserved pool). PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/432. Also toggled burst-queue to low-latency mode for that window.
Tony: Heads up — current autoscaler policy caps burst at 20 until 07:10. I'll push a short-lived override in a minute. Any quota constraints we need to know about in apac1?
Kevin: Soft quota is 48 GPUs in apac1; 40 reserved is okay but spot fallback capacity is limited. I created ENG-9813 to request an extra spot pool if needed.
Sasha: Can someone review Priya's PR quickly? Tiny change: prewarm count + queue gate. Also want to ensure canary routing keeps latency-critical flows on dedicated pool.
Priya: Reviewing now. @Kevin can you confirm the canary traffic split? I think we need 10-15% to dedicated for the surge.
Kevin: Updated canary to 5% -> 15% for 07:20-07:40. Config snippet: `traffic: { dedicated: 15, hosted: 85 }`. Deployed to stage.
oncall-bot: Deploy scheduled at 07:05 UTC to apply autoscaler override. Watch window: 2m. Incident channel watch enabled.
Tony: After deploy I'll monitor queue-depth and tokens/sec. If queue length > 120 reqs for >3m I'll flip spillover to eu-west and notify.
Sasha: Blocker: saw intermittent KV cache spikes on a couple hosts during last warmup. @Priya can you validate the warming script in the PR?
Priya: Running a focused load test now against the warming script, will post results in ~5m. Also added an extra retry on cache populate.
Kevin: Quick cost note — simulator shows ~+18% token cost during the surge window if batching drops. Suggest temporary quantization on background reranker models to save token-cost.
Sasha: Agree to limit quantization to rerankers for this window only. I'll file a short Optimize ticket after we stabilize.
Tony: LGTM. Standing by dashboards (queue, p50/p95 latency, token throughput). Will call out any anomaly. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Deploy finished — autoscaler override applied, no errors reported.
Priya: Load test result: KV warming reduced cold fills by ~60%, tail latency down ~120ms. Prewarm ready.
Sasha: Excellent. Thanks everyone. I'll keep this thread open until 08:00 and close if stable. If anyone needs hands-on, ping here or escalate to incidents.
